body:
Hello to all trippers,I'm a boy from Italy,near Slovenia(1 km),I want to tell you a strange thing that never happened before.
About 1 hour after taking 2,5 grams of hawaiian,I've forgotten my name and my look, I must gone in front of mirror to see who really am I and what's my face!  I was really scared to see it!
Then I speak to nobody in italian, but it seems to me like Japanese language! I was lied down in my bed, and it seems like a space-ship,and the walls were full of stars.  I didn't know where the fuck I was!
After 6 hours I realize that doesn't mean anything how many trips you have made in your life:everyone is always different from the previous.
